_comment: Per-item overrides for Invoke-WsoContentTest.ps1 (see UEM-API-TESTING-SPEC.md). Keyed by the inventory Name column. Anything not listed here is tested with the defaults: a Script is expected to report Completed (exit 0) on every test device, a Sensor is expected to report a value that parses as its declared Data Type. Keys: skip (reason string: never tested), expect (Completed | Failed | NoResult, the last for a script that powers the device off before Hub can report, so no result within timeoutMinutes is the pass), variables (name -> value for $env:-backed parameters), match (regex the sensor value must satisfy), min / max (numeric bounds for Integer sensors), allowEmpty (true when an empty String value is acceptable), expectNoValue (true for a Boolean/DateTime sensor that emits nothing when its data source is absent; Hub rejects an empty typed value, so 'no value stored' is the pass condition on a device without the product), timeoutMinutes (per-item override of the wait for a result), onlyInGroup (smart group name; the item is skipped unless the run targets exactly that group, used for session-ending or network-severing scripts so the machine running the tool is never in scope), note (free text carried into the result file). Expectations marked 'lab VM' assume the disposable VMware lab build (no Wi-Fi, no Trellix, no SCOM, no Office). Revisit them on a product VM.

Invoke-SimpleReboot.ps1.note: Reboots the target 5 minutes after exit 0 (shutdown.exe /t 300). Only against the single-VM group so the machine running the tool is never in scope. Device-side proof: System event 1074 and uptime reset on CHASEWIN11_2.

Invoke_RebootWithUserDefer_1.2.0.7.ps1.note: Installs the deferral orchestrator task and exits 0; the prompt and eventual reboot happen later. Completed proves the install. Needs a signed-in user on CHASEWIN11_2 to see the toast; the deferral and forced reboot are then validated by hand (TEST-VALIDATION.md section 11).

DEX_Invoke-SignoffWindows.ps1.note: Logs every interactive session off the target at once. Hub runs as SYSTEM and reports after the logoff. Device-side proof: Winlogon event 7002 on CHASEWIN11_2.

DEX_Start-LockDeviceSoft.ps1.note: Disconnects the console session on the target with tsdiscon.exe, which lands on the lock screen. Needs a signed-in user on CHASEWIN11_2 to have any effect; exit 0 either way.

DEX_LockDevice-BitlockEncryptionActivate.note: Positive path: CHASEWIN11_2 has BitLocker on C: with a password protector (enabled 2026-10-30, no TPM, policy EnableBDEWithNoTPM). From v1.3.0 the script suspends the protectors, schedules the power-off 15 s out through shutdown.exe and exits 0, so Hub reports Completed with the manage-bde output before the device goes down. Afterwards boot the VM (no password prompt while suspended), confirm manage-bde -status C: shows Protection Off, then manage-bde -protectors -enable C:. On a device whose protection is not On, the script throws and exits 1 (Failed) without powering off; set expect to Failed to prove that guard (run c8e0dd on 1.1.0 showed the exit-code-only guard did not hold; run 534500 on 1.2.0 could only be judged as no result because of the in-process /t 0).

DEX_Stop-WindowsUpdate.ps1.skip: Disables Windows Update and sets a 35-day pause on the test device. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 9.4.

DEX_Start-WindowsUpdate.ps1.skip: Forces an update install on the test device, which can leave it pending a restart mid-sweep. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 9.5.

Start-UserProfileCleanup.ps1.note: Deletes local (non-enrollment) profiles unused for more than 30 days with hard-coded tunables and no dry-run mode, so only against the snapshotted single VM. On CHASEWIN11_2 no profile meets the age threshold, so Completed proves the enumeration and the no-delete path; the deletion path needs a planted stale profile and is a manual test (General-Testing-Guide.md 2.2).

Invoke-AutoRemediateNetworkStack.ps1.note: Resets adapters and Winsock on the target, which drops its network for a while; Hub reports once connectivity returns, hence the longer wait. Only against the single-VM group. Also covered by its break test on the lab VM.

Start-DefenderFullScan.ps1.skip: Starts a multi-hour Defender full scan on the test device and slows every later case. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 4.7.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMAgent.ps1.skip: Reference copy only: 48,336 characters exceeds the UEM 32,767 limit and the create call will be refused. Parts 1-3 are the deployable split.

Restart-WinService.ps1.note: Print Spooler exists on every Windows build and restarts cleanly.

Restart-WinProcess.ps1.note: High impact: run with -IncludeHighImpact. Target chosen 2026-10-30: Chrome is on the lab VMs and supports both the blunt and the graceful restart. Exits 0 when no matching process is running, so a device without Chrome open passes trivially; the device-side proof is Chrome's PIDs changing. Under UEM the relaunch runs as SYSTEM in session 0, so the user does not see the new window; that is a design limitation to record, not a test failure.

Restart-WinProcessGraceful.ps1.note: High impact: run with -IncludeHighImpact. Dispatch-only script: Completed proves the watchdog task was registered and started. The outcome is in %ProgramData%\AirWatch\Extensions\ProcessGraceful (watchdog.log, result.json) and the process_graceful_lastresult sensor. Chrome must be open on the device for anything to happen.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMAgentPart1.ps1.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed (an agent upgrade is often the preferred fix).

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMAgentPart2.ps1.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMAgentPart3.ps1.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed.

Invoke-AutoRemediateDriverIssues.ps1.note: Filter matches the VMware devices on the lab VM. Scan/Restart only by default; the escalation chain is covered by the unit tests and break tests.

Invoke-DriverUpdates.ps1.note: Detect mode exits 1 whenever any driver update is offered, which UEM shows as Failed. The no-match filter pins exit 0 and proves the variables reach the script. Install mode is a manual test (TEST-VALIDATION.md 5.2).

Invoke-AutoRemediateWiFiSignalIssues.ps1.note: Lab VM has no Wi-Fi adapter, so step 1 fails by design and the script exits 1. Remove this expectation on a device with a wireless adapter.

Invoke-TrellixRefreshPolicies.ps1.note: Throws 'CmdAgent.exe was not found' without Trellix installed. Pins the guard on the lab VM; remove on a Trellix device.

Invoke-TrellixLocalUpdate.ps1.note: Without Trellix both executables are reported as not found and the script exits 0. Completed on the lab VM proves only the skip path.

Invoke-CrowdStrikeServiceRemediation.ps1.note: No Falcon on the lab VM; Completed proves only the 'nothing to remediate' path. Fixed 2026-10-29.

Invoke-TrendMicroServiceRemediation.ps1.note: No Trend Micro on the lab VM; Completed proves only the not-found path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateOutlook.ps1.note: Outlook is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateTeams.ps1.note: Teams is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateZoom.ps1.note: Zoom is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateAppXBloat.ps1.note: Deprovisions consumer inbox AppX packages on the test device. Expected and acceptable on a disposable VM; the first run changes the image.

Enable-HardwareAcceleratedGPUScheduling..note: Exits 1 on the run that enables HwSchMode (no re-detect) and 0 on every later run. A Failed verdict on a fresh device is expected once; re-run to confirm.

Invoke-RemediatePageFile.ps1.note: Exits 1 (Warning) when the page file is manually sized but under threshold, or system-managed with high usage. On the lab VM the page file is system-managed, so Completed is expected.

Start-ClearRecycleBin.ps1.note: Empties every user's Recycle Bin on the test device. Keep the test smart group to disposable VMs.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMHealthServiceCac.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed. (Also: no SCOM agent on the lab VM.)

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMClonedIdentity.p.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed. (Also: no SCOM agent on the lab VM.)

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMMonitoringHost.p.skip: Deferred 2026-10-30: SCOM agent remediation is out of scope while the approach is reviewed. Launcher plumbing was proven under UEM in run 37acca (payload reached Skipped:NoAgent); keep that evidence.

sensor-getservice.ps1.skip: Sample only: emits the JSON list of every running service (about 2.4 KB). UEM stores at most 1 KB per sensor value and Hub drops the sample ('output length is greater than 1KB length', seen 2026-10-29).

Get-UserProfileSize.ps1.skip: Not sensor-shaped: writes 34 lines of log text, references an undefined CustomPSObject type and exits 1. Hub rejected it as 'failed sanity' on 2026-10-29. Needs a rewrite that emits one value before it can be a sensor.

performance_defender_scanorupdateactive..note: Hub rejected 1.0.0 as 'failed sanity' on both lab devices (2026-10-29) while an interactive run printed Idle. 1.0.1 silences the Get-WinEvent error stream; confirmed Idle on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_folder_redirection_map.ps1.note: Payload was ~1.2 KB and Hub dropped it as over 1 KB on 2026-10-29; the tenant's own published copy fails the same way on every sample. Restructured the same day (redirected targets plus local folder names); confirmed stored on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_folder_redirection_latency_probe.p.note: Payload was ~2.5 KB and Hub dropped it as over 1 KB on 2026-10-29. Restructured the same day (probe details only for redirected folders); confirmed stored on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_time.ps1.note: Lab VMs hold LogonTime = Unknown in the LogonDuration cache, so the sensor emits nothing and Hub rejects the empty DateTime. Passes with a value on a device where Measure-LogonDuration.ps1 has parsed a logon.

logon_shell_ready_time.ps1.note: Same cache state as logon_time.ps1 on the lab VMs.

logon_gp_start_time.ps1.note: Same cache state as logon_time.ps1 on the lab VMs.

vpn_last_connect_time.ps1.note: No VPN client on the lab VMs, so the cache has no LastConnectTime and the DateTime sensor emits nothing by design.

vpn_dns_configured.ps1.note: Documented: no value is emitted without an active tunnel, because false would read as a real finding.

scom_management_server_reachable.ps1.note: No SCOM agent on the lab VMs; the sensor returns without output when AgentInstalled is absent.

scom_healthservice_running_standalone.ps.note: No SCOM agent root on the lab VMs; the sensor returns without output by design.

vpn_adapter_name.ps1.note: Empty by design without a VPN adapter (lab VMs).

vpn_health_reason.ps1.note: Empty by design when the VPN cache has no HealthReason (lab VMs).

scom_agent_health_reason.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).

scom_agent_version.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).

scom_agent_version_standalone.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).
